QuestInfo.name: Leonore the Watchman
QuestInfo.0: Go see #b#p2152017##k in disguise as a Black Wings member and get some information.
QuestInfo.1: Watchman #p2152017# lost a ring. You won't get her attention until she finds it. It's a bit of a pain, but go find the #bring#k for #r#o1150000##k.\n\n#i4033121# #t4033121# #b#c4033121# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: #p2152017# said she joined the Black Wings to get away from loan sharks. Her job is to analyze #o1150000# recordings. It didn't look like she was doing a great job though.

0.0: Did they finally hire another watchman?! Thank heavens. We've been understaffed for months! I could barely get my quests done. Let me see if I can find you some work...
0.1: Oh, I got it! I lost my #bring#k and I want it back! Don't talk to me about your problems, just go get it!

yes.0: I told you to get to it! I lost it when I was checking a #r#o1150000##k data log a couple of days ago. Just go out to the field and start knocking those machines around until you find it.

no.0: I'm going straight to the managers about you!

1.0: Not bad, not bad. I was sure you were just some joker PRETENDING to be a Black Wing when you came up here earlier. What kind of idiot would do that, am I right?

yes.0: I'm glad to have this thing back. It's caused me a lot of grief. Had to join the Black Wings just to get away from the people who loaned me the money to buy it. I don't even know what we do here, I just know those loan sharks never bother me a bit!
yes.1: It's easy work. Takes about 30 seconds to look over a #o1150000# and file the report before I get back to my shopping. In fact, the only person I've met is the one who gives me my paycheck, #p2154002#. I bet you've met her.
yes.2: #b(Leonore seems to be a dead end. Time to head over to the next watchman.)#k

item.0: I told you, I lost my ring in a #r#o1150000##k! Go get it!
